Pull request: #444 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Branch `bb/relay-91-implementation-audit-fixes-23-23-host-g-thr_qwfddtgrxy` pushed to origin successfully. ## Summary Implements issue #91: two affinity-safe graphile-worker composition roots over the same Postgres-backed queue. - **`services/semprec-api/src/queueRuntime.ts`**: installs `CORE_CRONTAB`, hosts core/data handlers plus every `queueAffinity: 'api'` module task, runs the one-time `heartbeatFire` legacy-queue migration. - **`services/semprec-agents/`** (new service): installs no crontab, hosts the closed `heartbeatFireAgent`/`agentRun`/`delegatedAgentRun` catalog plus `queueAffinity: 'agents'` module tasks. - Both composition roots inject a process-owned `Pool`, run idempotent migrations, call `run()` exactly once, expose an idempotent `stop()` that never closes the pool, and wire their own SIGTERM/SIGINT handling (intake → runner → pool). - `assertTaskListMatchesAffinity` proves each runtime's registered handlers exactly match its resolved affinity set before startup completes, failing actionably on a missing, duplicate, or cross-affinity handler. - Added integration tests booting both compositions against ephemeral Postgres: affinity isolation (a job outside a runtime's affinity is never claimed), exactly-one-crontab installation, startup failure on a colliding module task name, and idempotent shutdown. - Updated `deploy/README.md` to describe `semprec-agents` as the second systemd-managed process sharing the queue's network/secrets contract. ## Verification - `backend/pnpm run verify` (build, lint, format, dependency-boundary checks, unit + integration + e2e tests) — passed - `web/pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, tests) — passed, no web files touched - Full integration suite: 115 files / 1473 tests passed; e2e suite: 9 tests passed Relay-Step-Status: pass

Pull request: #444 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-91-implementation-audit-fixes-23-23-host-g-thr_qwfddtgrxy` (confirmed present on origin at `696ab8b`). ## Summary This branch implements issue #91's graphile-worker composition roots for API and agents, and this update addresses the CI code-review feedback that landed on PR #444: **Fixed (blocking medium finding):** Removed the unused `runner: Runner` property from `ApiQueueRuntime`/`AgentsQueueRuntime` — only `.stop()` had a caller anywhere in the codebase. **Fixed (low findings):** Removed the always-true dead-code filter in `agentWorker.ts`'s handler map; retyped `handlers` as `Record<string, Task>` (instead of `TaskList`, whose upstream type has an optional index signature) so it type-checks without the guard. **New test coverage added for previously unmet acceptance criteria:** - Real-time observation of the `CORE_CRONTAB`-installed `heartbeatSweep` entry actually firing (AC24). - Positive ownership proof that `heartbeatSweep`/`trashPurge`/`approvalExecute`/`notificationFanout` execute only in the API runtime, and `heartbeatFireAgent` only in the agents runtime (AC25). - Proof that a legacy `heartbeatFire` job is migrated exactly once to its split task name at API composition-root install, without duplication (AC28). - True duplicate-task-name startup-rejection tests on both composition roots, via new fixture module pairs that deliberately collide (AC29). Remaining unmet items (AC21/22 systemd provisioning, AC16/AC30 ModuleRegistry-level enforcement) are intentionally left as-is — they fall outside this issue's stated scope (owned by #221) or are already exercised at the unit tier via the same shared validation path. Full verification passed in the foreground: build, lint, format, dependency boundaries, pi-import-paths, migration numbering, write-safety, unit tests (427), integration tests (1479), and e2e tests (9) — all green. Round-3 review fixes on top of the original implementation: - **AC18/AC27** (invalid-affinity startup failure): added tests in both composition roots' suites proving that a module task with a `queueAffinity` value outside `["api", "agents"]` is rejected by `ModuleRegistry.loadModule`'s manifest validation before either runtime starts, using new fixture modules per service. - **AC22** (test-specific crontab cadence): replaced a real up-to-75s wait with a deterministic test that pre-seeds `graphile_worker._private_known_crontabs` and installs a crontab line carrying a `?fill=` backfill window, so the sweep fires immediately at startup instead of waiting on a real minute boundary. - **AC23** (deterministic heartbeat execution): strengthened the legacy `heartbeatFire` migration test to also prove the migrated `heartbeatFireCore` job is actually claimed and invoked (`attempts >= 1`) by the API runtime, not just present after migration. - Also carried forward from round 2: dropped the unused `runner` property from both runtime interfaces, removed a dead-code filter, and fixed the resulting TypeScript build break by retyping `agentWorker.ts`'s local task-handler map as `Record<string, Task>`. Full verification pipeline passed in this session: build, lint, format, boundary/import/migration/write-safety checks, unit tests (427/427), integration tests (1481/1481), and e2e tests (9/9).
